runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_08fedf0f2ffeThyTZYza9p379q] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
On **20 June 2026 (UTC)** there were **7,180 mainnet blocks**. The first-seen arrival time stats (minimum time from slot start for a block to be observed by any node):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Min arrival | 141 ms |
| Median | 1,453 ms |
| Average | 1,710 ms |
| P95 | 3,126 ms |
| Max | 5,249 ms |

The raw data (slot, time, block_root, first_seen_ms, observations) was truncated at 1000 rows but is saved at `/tmp/panda-opencode-seuma856/share/opencode/tool-output/tool_f7012a7390017O1HL9o9CBERUc`.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_08fedf0f2ffeThyTZYza9p379q] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart created: **Block first-seen arrival time distribution — mainnet 2026-06-20**

![Arrival distribution](http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/fc86214358e0/ae0d074d-6f5d-4ef1-b7ff-37c12e0bd039/arrival_distribution.png)

Key finding: majority of mainnet blocks arrive within 2 seconds of slot start. The histogram shows a peak around 1–1.5s with a long tail extending to ~5.2s.
